interaction_with_cleanup: PLAN mode: no effect on mount behavior
ARCHIVE mode: sets status=ARCHIVED, disables auto-mount
FREEZE mode: sets status=FROZEN, disables auto-mount
PRUNE mode: removes CACHE/STALE/DUPLICATE, mount still works
DELETE mode: removes project, mount impossible
